items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1975-02-03
items.q: And if Stanley Mendelsohn is in shape we could use him too.

ctx.x: Well we can still manage with trombone and cornet though. There are still some trombone and cornet players. But clarinet players who can play the harmonic role of a clarinet in a jazz band, we don't have. As you recall we found that Eddie Miller was in shape to play clarinet last time, and he hadn't played in thirty years, but he broke out his clarinet and we did make a session. And I don't know what we're going to do exactly next time. I have some plans, enough to cut four more sessions. But we only have the two…
and we could use them to play the piano for each session. Well there's a young stuff that plays right, Dan.
